drifted.spec_text: Diagnostics MUST route through an optional ILogger receptacle; a missing logger MUST NOT turn any operation into an error.
drifted.actual: Primary diagnostics route through ILogger via log_debug and tolerate a missing logger (aligned), but async-event instrumentation prints via eprintln!, bypassing ILogger. Documented in spec Known Limitations with a tracked align-task.

unspecced.feature: Device async-event instrumentation (TAG_ASYNC epoll fd, drain_async_events, async_event_name, FFI responder_async_fd/responder_drain_async_event)
unspecced.suggested_spec: Already documented in spec Known Limitations (backfilled 2026-08-07); best-effort operator diagnostics, no FR needed unless it becomes load-bearing.

unspecced.feature: Command-bridge thread (rdma-responder-cmd-bridge) draining the SPSC command inbox onto the command eventfd
unspecced.suggested_spec: Note the FR-004 SPSC->eventfd bridge mechanism in plan.md/data-model.
